scripts.dev: concurrently -n BE,FE -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:stg: concurrently -n BE,FE -c yellow,green "npm run dev:stg --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.prod: npx tsx scripts/prod-guard.ts "start PRODUCTION servers" && concurrently -n BE,FE -c red,green "npm run dev:prod --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:push:local --prefix backend && npm run seed:local --prefix backend
scripts.db:setup:stg: npm run db:push:stg --prefix backend && npm run seed:stg --prefix backend
scripts.start: npm run db:setup && npm run dev
scripts.start:stg: npm run db:setup:stg && npm run dev:stg
